newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 32.404 (32.356).
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank crown/dollar fix at 32.404 (32.356).

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) fixed the crown at 32.404 to the dollar after Friday's fixing at 32.356, and at 19.798 to the mark from 19.819.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (1040 GMT), and is within plus/minus 5.0 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated at 1130.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of -0.26 percent, after a deviation of -0.26 percent on Friday.
At the time of calculation, the crown was trading on the interbank market at -0.34 versus the basket.
